hook: Any number, any size — one glance is enough.

instagram.caption:
Any number, any size — one glance is enough.

Checking if 4 divides a number? You don't need to work through the whole thing.

Only the last two digits matter — because 100 is already a multiple of 4.

Take 552. Look at 52. Four goes into 52, so four goes into 552.

Save this and try it on any number you like.
